name: Koldunic Sorcery — 3 Advanced — The Inmost Tug

system.description:
Unlike most Koldunic rituals, the Inmost Tug requires no blood sacrifice or other dross; it can be activated with a single word and gesture. It allows a voivode to reach into the heart of a being bound to her by the Blood Oath and reshape the emotion the Oath instills. The love a thrall feels could be debased into lust, refined into fraternal devotion, or warped into fear, hatred, or any other consuming passion the koldun desires — the bond itself remains, but its emotional flavor is remade.

System: The koldun wins a Social Challenge (retesting with Empathy) against the bound target's Willpower to reshape the emotional character of an existing Blood Oath. The bond's strength and duration are unaffected; only the emotion it produces changes, and it persists until the koldun alters it again.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis I: Masters of the State, Book Two: Tzimisce
